thread:
Nora (sales): TradePort wants a POC to be a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX's /generate. They care about prompt parity, token billing delta, SAML SSO, and BYOK for prod. Minimal gates?
Chen (solutions): Minimal gates: API envelope mapping shim, canonical parity suite, token accounting + billing delta estimate, security/legal signoff, and a clear rollback fallback.
Akira (presales): I'll prepare 12 prompts covering summarize, rewrite, extraction, code, and tricky unicode/emoji cases. We'll run side-by-side diffs and a small human check sample.
Liam (ML Eng): Heads-up: CompetitorX tokenizes some smart quotes and emoji sequences differently; expect ~4-9% token variance on edge cases. We'll include a compat pre-token-normalize step and a "mirror-mode" variant to tweak repetition_penalty.
Rina (Security): For POC platform-managed KMS is ok; production requires BYOK. Need SAML metadata, IP allowlist, retention <=30 days. Legal requires DPA before we ship raw prompts.
Nora (sales): TradePort asked for an example of response mapping to be drop-in. Can we show a tiny shim?
Chen (solutions): Example mapping (pseudo):
// competitor: {"id":"x1","output":"...","usage":{"tokens":120}}
// shim -> {"request_id":"x1","choices":[{"text":"..."}],"usage":{"total_tokens":120}}
Akira (presales): Acceptance criteria proposal: mean token delta <= 10% on canonical set, automated semantic-score delta within tolerance, human-pass >= 90% on sample, latency <=1.5x competitor in us-west, and zero PII exposures in outputs.
Liam (ML Eng): For cost modeling: show hosted vs dedicated. E.g., if token delta +7% on 30M tokens/month -> +2.1M tokens cost at our hosted rate; dedicated unit price will be lower. I'll produce a small calculator.
Rina (Security): Blocker: Legal needs DPA + export control review. @Nora please loop Legal before we share logs. Also I will draft security Q answers (KMS steps, audit log format, incident SLA).
provision-bot: staging cluster created: tradeport-poc-staging (egress IPs: 44.55.66.77, 44.55.66.78)
Nora (sales): Great. TradePort also asked for a 60-day trial credit and a ramped commit for Dedicated. Can we offer that?
Chen (solutions): Yes. Proposal: 60-day credits up to X tokens; months 2-3 ramp with 40% discount, month4+ standard committed pricing. I'll draft numbers.
Akira (presales): I'll build a Postman collection + a small runner that executes the 12 prompts against CompetitorX and our shim, then outputs TSV: prompt,redwood_text,competitor_text,redwood_tokens,competitor_tokens,latency_ms.
Liam (ML Eng): I'll add model variants to the matrix: quant-default, fp16, mirror-mode. Will record seed and commit hash in the repo.
Rina (Security): Action: I'll prepare security Q answers and confirm whether they want an on-prem evaluation.
Nora (sales): Looping Legal now. Scheduling sync with TradePort for Fri 10am PT. Action owners: @Akira harness, @Chen pricing, @Liam variants + cost calc, @Rina security + DPA check. Keep updates here or DM me for blockers.
